text: dsh-ai4scholar 是 DSH Web 学术插件，注册论文检索、元数据、全文阅读、引用整理和科研绘图工具，并提供积分命令与密钥设置卡片。它可搜索 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv，合并结果，查看作者与引用，并读取 PDF 文本；auto_cite 为学术段落补充引用和参考文献，sci_draw 生成或编辑科研图。适合查找论文、整理引用和制作配图。付费搜索及生成服务需要 AI4Scholar API Key；免费平台可单独使用。

dsh-ai4scholar brings academic search and paper reading to DSH Web. Search Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv, and medRxiv, or read PDF text. auto_cite adds references; sci_draw creates and edits figures. Billed features need an AI4Scholar key; free sources work separately.
想用 DSH 搜一遍不同学术平台，快速找相关论文。
帮我查某篇论文的作者、摘要、DOI 和引用次数。
我想读论文 PDF 的正文，最好能分段继续查看。
能不能从一段学术文字里补上合适的引用和参考文献？
找一些近期的 bioRxiv 或 medRxiv 预印本给我看看。
我需要为论文制作一张科研示意图，也想试试把现有图片改成另一种风格。
Find papers on this topic across several academic databases and combine duplicate results.
Look up a paper's citations, references, authors, and publication details.
Read the text of a research paper from its DOI or arXiv identifier.
Add real academic citations to my draft and return the references in APA or IEEE style.
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「论文搜索」：search_papers 可跨 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、arXiv 和 Google Scholar 合并去重结果，默认只查 Semantic Scholar。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「论文与作者信息」：从 Semantic Scholar 和 PubMed 搜索、批量读取论文详情，并查询作者资料、论文列表和推荐论文。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「预印本检索」：通过 arXiv、bioRxiv 和 medRxiv 的工具查找论文或按分类浏览近期预印本，并提供论文标识和摘要。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「论文全文阅读」：read_by_doi、read_arxiv_paper 等工具下载 PDF 并提取文本；可用 offset 和 max_chars 分段读取较长内容。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「自动添加引用」：调用 auto_cite 为学术段落匹配论文、插入引用标记，并输出指定格式的参考文献和可用的 BibTeX。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「科研绘图」：sci_draw 支持文本生成、图片编辑、风格转换、组合、迭代、评论、SVG 和矢量化等操作，可返回图片或可编辑文件。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「积分与密钥管理」：插件工具和 /ai4scholar 命令查询余额及本会话消耗，Web 设置卡片可保存、移除并测试 API Key。
dsh-ai4scholar 的功能「引用图谱与全文片段搜索」：Semantic Scholar 工具可查看论文引用和参考文献、搜索作者，并查找论文全文中与主题匹配的片段。
dsh-ai4scholar 使用 AI4Scholar 服务完成部分学术搜索、引用整理和科研绘图；这些调用通过 ai4scholar.net API 发送请求，并由请求头携带已配置的 API Key。
dsh-ai4scholar 的付费平台和生成工具需要 AI4Scholar API Key。默认凭据引用名为 AI4SCHOLAR_API_KEY；设置卡片将密钥交给 DSH 凭据服务管理，代码也支持从环境变量解析。

dsh-ai4scholar README · AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness：**Start with one source.** Omitting `sources` (or passing `[]`) queries only Semantic Scholar. For biomedical or clinical topics, select `sources: ["pubmed"]` as appropriate. Use multiple sources, such as `["semantic-scholar", "pubmed"]`, when broader coverage is explicitly requested or one source is insufficient. Each billed API request adds to the charge; Google Scholar bills per page, while arXiv is free. If Semantic Scholar is disabled, the default is the first enabled platform in this order: PubMed, arXiv, Google Scholar.

dsh-ai4scholar README · AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness：Every paper-list tool returns one normalized record shape — title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI/PMID/arXiv ids, URL, open-access PDF, abstract — so the model (and Code Mode programs) can chain calls across platforms without special cases. Results render as citation cards in the dsh Web UI; full-text tools return the PDF text in slices (`offset` / `max_chars`) so a 40-page paper never floods the context.

dsh-ai4scholar README · AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness：**Credits are visible.** Every billed tool card in the chat carries the charge in its title (`Semantic Scholar: protein folding · 10 credits · 4,990 left`), the model-facing result ends with `AI4Scholar credits — this call: 10 · this session: 40 · remaining: 4,960` (from the API's `X-Credits-*` headers) and the model is asked to close a billed turn with a one-line credit note; `/ai4scholar` renders a balance card (available credits, breakdown, membership, key status, session spend) and `get_ai4scholar_credits` gives the model the same numbers. Free platforms (arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, DOI) carry no credit line.

dsh-ai4scholar README · Configuration：The bundle mounts one row (`id: ai4scholar`) with these defaults. Override from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the whole `config`, so restate every key you keep):

```yaml
- id: ai4scholar
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: AI4SCHOLAR_API_KEY   # credential reference; the key itself never lives in config
    baseUrl: https://ai4scholar.net

dsh-ai4scholar README · Configuration：The API key is resolved **per call** through `ctx.credentials`, so storing or rotating it takes effect on the next tool call without a restart. When the credentials service is absent (a custom composition), the plugin falls back to `process.env[apiKeyEnv]`.

dsh-ai4scholar README · Configuration：The settings card always edits `AI4SCHOLAR_API_KEY` (the browser half does not receive the row config); a deployment that overrides `apiKeyEnv` manages that reference through the environment or the credentials file instead. The session credit tally is process-local (it restarts with dsh); the balance itself always comes from the API.

dsh-ai4scholar README · How it fits dsh：- Two halves in one package: the Node half registers the tools; the browser half (`exports["./client"]`, declared by `dsh.client`) contributes the settings card through native `plugins.bundle.config` / `plugins.row.config` slots and `settings.section` (plus `settings.plugin.item` on older hosts) and talks to the Host only through the credentials wire API — the key literal never rides a response, and it never reaches the model.
- Tools are registered on `ctx.tools` with `defineTool`: typed, schema-validated arguments; a canonical JSON value per call (`{ source, query, total, papers[], truncated, nextOffset? }`); a Markdown rendering for the model; and a `web` result card (structured sources) for the Web UI.
- A single `tool:ai4scholar` system-prompt section tells the model when to use which platform and to cite by DOI/link.
- Everything is an effect: unloading the plugin (or editing its config, which triggers HMR) withdraws every tool and the prompt section.
- No model-visible input is added outside the tool results, so sessions stay fully replayable from the log.

dsh-ai4scholar README · Notes：- `download_by_doi` / `read_by_doi` resolve through doi.org and known publisher PDF patterns (Elsevier, Springer/Nature, Wiley, T&F, MDPI, IEEE, ACM, ACS, RSC, PLOS, Frontiers, bioRxiv/medRxiv, arXiv). Paywalled articles only download when dsh runs on a network with institutional access; a refusal names the landing page so the user can fetch it by hand.
- Full-text extraction uses `pdf-parse` (pdf.js) in-process; scanned/image-only PDFs yield an explicit error rather than empty text.
- The same tool set ships for [OpenClaw](https://github.com/literaf/ai4scholar-plugin-openclaw), [Codex](https://github.com/literaf/ai4scholar-plugin-codex) and [Hermes](https://github.com/literaf/ai4scholar-plugin-hermes).
